description: Confirmatory rerun of the selected S=.75/U=.50 arm from the independent standard-lane target screen, paired against flat fee and canonical D16/K10 with the patient demand-census control, on the disjoint seed range 200-299. All other inputs (D16, windows 20/5, half-RB threshold, K10) stay fixed. The census arm always first-submits and supplies the common offered-demand denominator; its own inclusion outcomes are not candidates.
